title: No locus standi for Pak to comment on India's internal affairs: Mandaviya in Doha summit
description: NEW DELHI, Nov 5: Union Minister of Labour and Employment Mansukh Mandaviya on Wednesday said Pakistan has no locus standi to comment on India’s internal affairs, and it should stop abusing global forums. The minister asserted that Pakistan is engaged in acts of cross-border terrorism against Indian citizens and advised the neighbouring country to introspect.
